project_type: Twitch chat analysis web app with SSE, WebSocket client, background timers; currently Node.js/Express, converting to Python/Flask
verification_instructions:
1. Install dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt
2. Run tests: pytest test/
3. Start server: python app.py (loads .env)
4. Test SSE: curl http://localhost:3000/api/events
5. Test API: curl http://localhost:3000/api/state
6. Test static files: curl http://localhost:3000/
7. Test OAuth flow: visit http://localhost:3000/auth/twitch
8. Test demo mode endpoints
environment_constraints: Must run in worktree /Users/akshayalnyn/Documents/Hackathon/Twitch Codex/.worktrees/python-conversion on branch python-conversion. Never modify files in main workspace /Users/akshayalnyn/Documents/Hackathon/Twitch Codex. Use python-dotenv to load .env. Flask SSE requires Response with mimetype text/event-stream and yield. WebSocket client (websocket-client library) runs in background thread. Batch timer runs in background thread with threading.Timer.
contribution_requirements: Preserve exact business logic from server.js. All API endpoints must remain identical. Frontend public/index.html must work without changes. All environment variables preserved (.env). NVIDIA API integration exact: endpoint https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions, model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b, Bearer auth, temperature 0.2, response_format json_object. OAuth flow identical. Demo mode scenarios preserved exactly.
key_patterns: server.js: Express app with 600+ lines, all logic in one file; global session object; SSE via res.write; WebSocket client for Twitch EventSub; setInterval for batch processing; classify() function uses regex; scoreMessage() calculates RQNU scores; processBatch() clusters messages and updates queue; analyzeWithNvidia() calls NVIDIA API; OAuth state stored in Map with cookie validation; demo mode uses setInterval with scenarios array. Tests: node:test with assert.equal/assert.ok, export functions for testing. Frontend: vanilla JS, EventSource for SSE, fetch for API calls, no changes needed.
